meta.basis_label: Based on 2025/26 · updates as the new season plays
meta.pool_rule: Hit rate is the share of a player's starts that reached the threshold. Leaderboards require at least 19 starts in 2025/26.

opponent_effect.note: DefCon follows the player, not the fixture: opponent shifts it by about 2% in 25/26 data (7,382 player-matches). Bonus is the stat that moves with fixtures.
